law.source_scope: OFFICIAL CME Group surfaces only: bytes served by hosts www.cmegroup.com and ftp.cmegroup.com that the official pages themselves reference or that are publicly served without authentication. The CmeWS/mvc JSON family is the transport the official JS-rendered pages themselves call on the same host; it is classified here, BEFORE any fetch, as 'official page as served' — not a third-party or undocumented endpoint. No third-party mirror, no scraping in violation of terms, no VPN/ECH/fronting/SNI games, no account creation, no terms acceptance, no new keys.
law.byte_cap_rule: cumulative bytes tracked after EVERY fetch; approaching cap -> STOP fetching, record honestly

head_census.per_instrument_years: sampled-years {2019,2021,2023,2025,2026} x >=8 stratified HEAD probes of the settlement/volume surface for that year (existence proofs)
head_census.etiquette: sequential, >=1s spacing, <=2 retries with exponential backoff, no concurrency, single session
head_census.census_manifest: the concrete URL template and probe list is frozen in census_manifest.json AFTER the canary fetches identify the official surface's own transport, BEFORE the first probe

law.determinism: re-fetch >=5 already-fetched artifacts after all fetches; prove sha256 ALL_MATCH or document archive-immutability behavior with evidence
law.transcripts: every HTTP interaction -> fetch_transcripts.jsonl (url, method, http_status, content_type, byte_size, sha256, fetched_at_utc)
law.block_law: a connection-level or HTTP-level measured block is EVIDENCE (BLOCKED_TRANSPORT input). On a connection-level block: run the SNI/destination-IP discrimination experiment (DoH-verified authentic IP vs blocked hostname; same-IP different-SNI control; neutral control site), record all transcripts, NEVER bypass.

per_instrument_product_pages.discovery_rule: URLs above are frozen CANDIDATES reached from the official /markets/fx/ product family. On 404/redirect, the canonical page will be located ONLY by following official navigation links contained in already-fetched official cmegroup.com pages (in-bounds traversal), every hop recorded in transcripts.

recent_daily_settlement.rule: ONE recent daily settlement fetch (a single recent trade date) per instrument, from the settlement surface the official page itself serves. tradeDate is chosen at fetch time = most recently completed trading day measured at that moment, recorded verbatim in the transcript.

historical_sample.rule: ONE historical settlement or volume/OI sample from ONE of the sampled years {2019,2021,2023,2025,2026} per instrument, from the same official surface. The sampled year for the per-instrument canary is frozen per fetch in the transcript; the year GRID is exercised by the HEAD census.

fees_documentation.rule: official exchange + clearing fee documentation page(s); official fee-schedule PDFs reached by following links served in official pages are in scope

margin_documentation.rule: official margin documentation (plan input, A7 r1 F-3); linked official margin/SPAN resources as publicly served are in scope

license_terms_pages.rule: official legal/terms surfaces; hash EVERY page relied on; quote operative use/redistribution clauses VERBATIM

client_behavior_frozen.user_agent: honest default curl client, no disguise
client_behavior_frozen.compression: none requested (raw bytes hashed as served)
